name: Medications
description: Track daily medications for every family member. Check off doses as they're taken, get a nudge at each scheduled time, and let a family member know when a dose is missed.

source.query: SELECT m.id AS id, m.name AS title, NULLIF(m.dosage, '') AS subtitle, m.member_id AS member_id, CASE WHEN m.reminder_times LIKE '["__:__"%' THEN substr(m.reminder_times, 3, 5) ELSE :today END AS when_at, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.dose_date) >= (CASE WHEN m.reminder_times LIKE '[%,%' THEN LENGTH(m.reminder_times) - LENGTH(REPLACE(m.reminder_times, ',', '')) + 1 ELSE 1 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS done FROM app_medication_tracker__medications m LEFT JOIN app_medication_tracker__doses d ON d.medication_id = m.id AND d.dose_date = :today WHERE m.archived = 0 AND m.reminders_on = 1 AND (m.started_on IS NULL OR m.started_on = '' OR m.started_on <= :today) AND (m.ends_on IS NULL OR m.ends_on = '' OR m.ends_on >= :today) AND (m.days_mask = '' OR (',' || m.days_mask || ',') LIKE ('%,' || CASE strftime('%w', :today) WHEN '0' THEN '7' ELSE strftime('%w', :today) END || ',%')) AND (m.every_n_days IS NULL OR m.started_on IS NULL OR m.started_on = '' OR (CAST(julianday(:today) - julianday(m.started_on) AS INTEGER) % m.every_n_days) = 0) GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY m.created_at LIMIT 20

SELECT name AS title, NULLIF(dosage, '') AS subtitle, member_id AS member_id FROM app_medication_tracker__medications WHERE archived = 0 AND reminders_on = 1 AND (started_on IS NULL OR started_on = '' OR started_on <= :today) AND (ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on = '' OR ends_on >= :today) AND (days_mask = '' OR (',' || days_mask || ',') LIKE ('%,' || CASE strftime('%w', :today) WHEN '0' THEN '7' ELSE strftime('%w', :today) END || ',%')) AND (every_n_days IS NULL OR started_on IS NULL OR started_on = '' OR (CAST(julianday(:today) - julianday(started_on) AS INTEGER) % every_n_days) = 0) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 3
